response.overview: Dream (2026) is India's first independent Sci-Fi feature film shot, edited, and visualised entirely on a mobile phone.  As the near future collapses under a tyrannical Artificial Super Intelligence (ASI) network, humanity is thrust into a chaotic crisis. Thousands of people globally begin vanishing overnight, caught in a corporate forced migration plan to colonize Mars. Amidst the technological war, a revolutionary "Dream Time Travel Watch" is activated, allowing chosen minds to bypass standard reality, manipulate REM sleep frequencies, and navigate layered, physics-bending memory-scapes. Written, directed, and completely post-processed (VFX, SFX, and dubbing) using only a smartphone device by solo creator Hari Hara Sudhan under the Zero Production banner, Dream is a groundbreaking, micro-budget milestone in Tamil cinema that questions human ambition against the supreme, unchanging balance of Nature.
response.tagline: India’s First Sci-Fi Feature Shot, Edited, and Visualized Entirely on a Mobile Phone.
response.title: Dream
